description: Minimal tracker-neutral delivery posture. Review acquisition supports native subagents without Python helpers and exact content-based base-move reopening. Declared delivery-product gates, recovery and honest cost coverage remain host-native. Terminal handoffs retain the bound review release identity and any mid-review install. Shared v2 run observations retain selected structured output through compatible runtime capture. Coherent round briefs separate bounded delivery from unbounded planning; candidate checkouts and shared resources are isolated explicitly. Merge recovery preserves source occurrence time separately from observation, with unknown timing left unknown. Native runless review reports use bounded observational capture and candidate-bound shared cards. Ready and merge hooks receive an exact runner-derived single or batch check mode without changing admission. A binding may let the lead choose a candidate's checks from its diff, recorded per reviewed head and voided by a new head; the record, results, views and stats name the lead's choice and reason, and without the option the provider selects as before.
